claims.text: WPP Production reports 95% faster strategy creation, 1,000 times more creative versions for hyper-targeted adaptation, and an average 17% lift in campaign engagement from its shaping performance model.
WPP Production demonstrated a full-funnel, multi-audience strategy for a fictional fragrance brand built in under three minutes, with messaging shaped to audience values, funnel stage and platform.
Salesforce's Agentforce Engagement Agent has reached 100,000 leads, created 1,500 opportunities that might otherwise have been left behind, and is on track to generate $60 million in pipeline.
Since launch, Agentforce has made quote creation at Salesforce 75% faster and reduced clicks in the quoting process by 87%.
Salesforce reports that executive briefs, which used to take over an hour, can now be generated 98% faster with Agentforce.
Salesforce reports that win rates among account executives have increased 10% with Agentforce Sales Coach, and that managers save hours of coaching time.
Salesforce reports that Agentforce and Data 360 helped sellers create 4,500+ opportunities and build quotes 75% faster.
Bertelsmann's Content Search replaced searches across multiple systems that used to take hours with a process that now takes seconds.
Bertelsmann's AI Hub team built its multi-agent Content Search system on LangGraph, a general agent framework, and took it from prototype to full production deployment.
Bertelsmann Content Search uses a coordinator agent that analyzes each user question and routes it to the relevant agents.
Bertelsmann Content Search sends routed queries to a central parallelized node that triggers domain agents: Publishing, Broadcasting, News and Web Intelligence.
Bertelsmann Content Search agents interface with vector databases (e.g. Qdrant) for semantic search, APIs for structured queries, graph databases for relationship lookups, and custom tools.
Bertelsmann Content Search synthesizes individual agent responses into a single answer, and users can chat directly with an individual agent to drill down.
Bertelsmann Content Search orchestrates searches across existing platforms and data sources rather than centralizing all data in one system.
With LangGraph, individual Bertelsmann agents can be deployed as standalone APIs; for example, the news archive agent can be integrated directly into internal teams' systems.

Bertelsmann's AI Hub says LangGraph offered reliability and predictability for production systems, and the LangChain ecosystem provided the observability and debugging needed to move from prototype to production.
WPP Production's agentic workflow uses a master orchestrator agent that pulls on specialist agents, coordinating tasks dynamically rather than sequentially.
WPP Production's workflow includes human check-in points, such as an email to the strategist saying the strategy is ready for review.
WPP Production trains its agents on the brand's DNA, guidelines and tone of voice to keep creative output consistent.
WPP Production uses pre-flight agents that assess and predict how well creative will perform before it is launched.
WPP Production uses synthetic-persona focus groups to test strategy; one test flagged that a thumbs-up icon can be read as rude in Turkey.
WPP Production says human strategists and creators supply the originality, cultural nuance and emotional understanding that AI lacks.

Salesforce's Engagement Agent sends outbound introduction emails, answers multitouch product questions, books meetings on calendars, handles opt-out requests, and hands leads to an SDR when they are ready.

Salesforce's Agentforce uses retrieval-augmented generation through Data 360 over pricing pages, product specifications, messaging guidelines and internal sales articles, and has built-in guardrails preventing it from surfacing unauthorized deal information.

Salesforce's Agentforce auto-logs the actions it takes on a lead so SDRs can review them, and its quoting is powered by the Atlas Reasoning Engine pulling live data from Agentforce Revenue Management and Agentforce Sales.
